crates/warlock-engine/src.purpose: This is warlock's core crate source: it walks a repository into a tree, decides each directory's freshness state, gathers and budgets files into a pass request, fills and renders a WARLOCK.md document, and writes the pacts, manifest, sigils and scope config that record and bound the result.

structure.line: load_tree builds a Tree of Node values, each carrying a NodeState and scope, which pact.rs then pacts into WARLOCK.md and manifest.rs persists as PactEntry rows.
decide_state compares a PactEntry's recorded hash (from manifest.rs) against a freshly computed subtree_hash (from hash.rs) to settle NodeState.
fitting.rs's fit walks and budgets files (using languages.rs's skeleton/elide to shrink over-cap files) into a Request defined in agent.rs, which an Agent runs.
document.rs's accept/mend/render turn an Agent Response into a Fill and then into the WARLOCK.md body that claude_md.rs and pact.rs write to disk.
scope.rs's validate_scope/validate_sigil and scope_opens_to govern the scopes stored on Node/PactEntry and the sigils sigils.rs loads/saves.
briefs.rs's load_briefs reads briefs.toml beside the manifest that manifest.rs locates via manifest_path.
ignores.rs's is_ignored and clock.rs's now_rfc3339 are small standalone helpers used elsewhere in this directory (file walking and timestamping).

rules.line: briefs.rs's check_relative rejects absolute or parent-component directories for briefs.
hash.rs's subtree_hash honors .warlock and ignore rules via files_under when hashing a directory.
document.rs pins caps: ENTRY_CHARS, ENTRY_MINIMUM, PURPOSE_CHARS, LIST_CAP.
fitting.rs bounds a request's size via REQUEST_BYTE_CAP and PER_FILE_BYTE_CAP.
scope.rs's wildcard "*" opens every scope per scope_opens_to.
tree.rs's Tree.walk() visits DepthFirst with parents before children.
clock.rs clamps to MIN_REPRESENTABLE/MAX_REPRESENTABLE rather than mis-spelling absurd dates.

crates/warlock-tui/src.purpose: The src directory is warlock's engine and TUI: it drives runs (pact/refresh) over a repo tree, enforces scope/sigil boundaries, chats with a claude agent to produce documents, and renders the tree/panel/composer interface handling input, drawing, and state.

structure.line: main.rs is the CLI entry and TUI event loop, parsing Cli/Command and driving Session's draw/point/press/paste/keep_up.
pacting.rs runs and drives a pact (Pact, Work, Running, spawn_pact, run_pact), calling into running.rs's pact/refresh entry points.
running.rs's Progress narrates each directory during a run and Report summarises failures, called via ran, descended.
edits.rs's Opened checks boundary access against Manifest scopes, and boundary.rs's verdict()/Reach/Verdict decide the actual scope access logic edits.rs relies on.
chatting.rs's Chat<C> drives a turn (ask/say, spawn_turn/run_turn/apply_turn) using claude.rs's ClaudeAgent/ChatAgent/Converses as the agent.
panel.rs's Panel/Showing/Card<T> display Account (account.rs), Thread (thread.rs), and Document content, and thread.rs's Thread/Turn model the chat conversation shown there.
ui.rs's draw() lays out the tree pane, panel, composer.rs's Composer, and footer, and hit_test maps points back to rows for input.rs's mouse_action.
scoping.rs's scope_press/scope_edit/scope_submit build prompt.rs's ScopePrompt and write edits back to the manifest.
watch.rs's Watch/WatchPolicy drive a debounced reload loop that session.rs's reload_tree and start_watching consume.
writing.rs's write_opened/write_edit/write_submit drive ScopePrompt (from prompt.rs) to produce a brief file via slug_of/next_number.
descent.rs's descend()/carry_on() drive a Pact/un-pact run over a subtree, tying into pacting.rs's Pact.

rules.line: COMPOSER_MAX_ROWS caps how much the composer can grow.
submission.rs refuses any submitted draft after the three commands /brief, /write, /chat with a single-line REFUSAL.
watch.rs coalesces filesystem events into reloads via QUIET_PERIOD/RELOAD_CEILING/COALESCED_RELOADS.
boundary.rs's Verdict renders a refusal for a closed scope or a hypothesis-only message for a blocking scope, per verdict().
edits.rs refuses edits across a closed boundary when granting or clearing a scope.
